Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: SPEAKING

• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do different Letter Sounds the learner should be able to: letters of the alphabet on the wall. letters sound?

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Articulation of Letter Sounds

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Articulation of Letter Sounds

Teach
• Focus skill: Demonstrate awareness of letter sounds after the teacher. 3. Which activities letter-sound •.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Articulation of Letter Sounds.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Articulation of Letter Sounds
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW
